description: This file contains unit tests for the heartbeat runner module, specifically testing the handling of scheduled reminders, event prompts, and message routing within the openclaw project. It utilizes Vitest testing framework and mocks external dependencies to validate behavior.

methods.name: createHeartbeatDeps
methods.description: Creates mock dependencies for Telegram messaging with specified reply text.

methods.name: createConfig
methods.description: Generates a configuration object for the heartbeat test environment, seeds session store, and returns session key.

methods.name: expectCronEventPrompt
methods.description: Validates that the system event context contains expected prompt details for cron reminders.

methods.name: runCronReminderCase
methods.description: Sets up and runs a heartbeat case specifically for cron reminder scenarios.

methods.name: runHeartbeatCase
methods.description: Executes a heartbeat routine within a sandbox environment, setting up mocks and verifying message content and routing.
